title: The General Intellect Playground Layer
thesis: A cumulative vertical layer running through all 26 sequences (F0-F209) of the Void Tower. Each sequence opens a new concrete possibility on the unified Bauhaus Studio Workstation and inside the 20m x 14m VR playground — progressing from base production (point, line, triangle, quad, package, coin, bomb) through motion, arrays, colour, pattern, force, wave, chance, noise, emergence, soft/implicit/boolean form, and finally into a thinking mind map for paradoxes, edges, crisis, and collective negotiation.

arcs.title: I · Production & Association
arcs.summary: Base Bauhaus spatial grammar (point -> line -> triangle -> solid -> quad), Template Building Stations (a12b12302: hanging glass box equips face_triangle/face_square onto wrist clock + 0.5m plinths; F5 Tetrahedron 4 / Diamond 8 -> Wireframe / Icosahedron 20; F7 Cube 6 & random association(cube) from terms.json), plus association() pickups: Package (F7 health + battery power-up), Bomb (F8 proximity blast), and Power Coin.

arcs.title: II · Motion, Agency & Logic
arcs.summary: Static elements begin to move (translate, rotate, scale) and Package, Power Coin, and Proximity Bomb become directly placeable inside the Playground Studio.

arcs.title: III · Arrays & Colour
arcs.summary: 1D, 2D, and 3D array stamping unlocks structural repetition; Colour releases the 6-Palette Chooser and surface spray-painting coats.

arcs.title: IV · Pattern, Force & Wave
arcs.summary: Procedural panel patterns (checker, diamond, stripe, 17-symmetry), Force Jump Forward & Sound Jump Pads, tension spans, and Big Pipe Systems.

arcs.title: V · Randomness, Noise & Shaders
arcs.summary: One-click Random Walk playground generation, hard-to-walk spiky Randomness basin surfaces, configurable walkable smooth Noise surfaces, and reactive shader skins.

arcs.title: VI · Automata, Fractals, L-Systems & ProcGen
arcs.summary: Neighbour-cell CA block control, recursive Menger Sponge playgrounds, L-system plant props fitted to the grid, and grammar-evolved procedural playgrounds.

arcs.title: VII · Softbodies, Isosurfaces & Booleans
arcs.summary: Deformable softbody canopies/pads, 4x4x4 isosurface cutouts (tunnel, crossing, dome, spiral ramp), and carved walkable boolean spaces.

arcs.title: VIII · Cities, Paradoxes, Crisis & Consciousness
arcs.summary: The playground transforms into a spatial mind map for thinking through swarm trails, graph topologies, error landscapes, paradoxes, edges, crisis, and collective negotiation.
